avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces perampanel plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor seizure control closely and consider perampanel dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 and increase seizure risk through GABA antagonism
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for reduced anticonvulsant efficacy

avoid_supplements.name: Kava kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk and potential CYP3A4 interactions; increases CNS depression and seizure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; avoid entirely due to compounded hepatic and seizure risks

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; mild CYP3A4 interaction potential
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation or dizziness

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on potential increased drowsiness; adjust activities as needed

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have anticonvulsant properties but generally supportive; mild antiplatelet effects
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe; may provide complementary seizure control support

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases perampanel plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; counsel patient on hidden sources in juices and supplements

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages (coffee, tea, energy drinks)
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP1A2 competition; caffeine may lower seizure threshold at high intakes
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake; monitor for increased irritability or seizure frequency at high consumption

caution_foods.name: Charred/grilled meats
caution_foods.mechanism: Heterocyclic amines may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing perampanel levels
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; maintain consistent dietary patterns to avoid fluctuating drug levels

monitoring_notes: Perampanel is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4; monitor for seizure breakthrough or toxicity signs (dizziness, ataxia, behavioral changes) when adding or removing CYP3A4 modulators. Counsel on strict avoidance of grapefruit and herbal inducers that may compromise seizure control.
